title: Unnecessary dependency: imports doing what builtins do

body.signal: External or heavyweight imports used for operations the stdlib covers (e.g. importing a statistics library to average a list).
body.failure_mode: Extra supply-chain and maintenance surface for no behavioral gain; heavyweight imports slow cold start and complicate sandboxing.
body.detection: Import-vs-usage analysis: list imported symbols, drop or replace those whose behavior a builtin or stdlib call reproduces identically.
body.fix_strategy: Replace with the stdlib equivalent. Gate: equivalence must hold exactly, not approximately - floating-point paths must match.

provenance.note: Seeded from hand-authored/analyzed artifacts; promoted by human decision, not agent replay.

counterfactual.evidence: N/A for seeds - promoted by human authorship at engine bootstrap.
